title: ステイヤーズSの後に・メジロの大計

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright completes the Stayers Stakes, proving that she has come into her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Along with her victories in the Satsuki Sho and Kikuka Sho, she's performed well in both medium and long-distance races. To Grandmother Mejiro, this is a sign of Mejiro Bright's versatility.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright walks along a glittering, starry path, carrying the family's hopes beyond the limit their founder had reached.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her resolve is renewed to run in the spring Tenno Sho, the race most important to the Mejiro family.
